# RMKC-STRONG-REL2: sole mathematical target

## Original target

Over the complex numbers, prove that every terminal Calabi–Yau fibre space
\(f:(X,\Delta)\to S\), in the sense of Li–Zhao (2025), with
\(\dim X-\dim S\leq2\), satisfies the strong relative Morrison–Kawamata movable cone conjecture. The total space is normal, projective and \(\mathbb Q\)-factorial and \(K_X+\Delta\equiv_S0\).

Set
\[
 V=N^1(X/S)_{\mathbb R},\qquad
 C=\overline{\operatorname{Mov}}(X/S)\cap\operatorname{Eff}(X/S),\qquad
 \Gamma=\operatorname{Im}\bigl(\operatorname{PsAut}(X/S,\Delta)\to\operatorname{GL}(V)\bigr).
\]
Find a rational polyhedral cone \(\Pi\subset C\) with
\[
 C=\bigcup_{\gamma\in\Gamma}\gamma\Pi,\qquad
 \operatorname{Int}(\Pi)\cap\operatorname{Int}(\gamma\Pi)=\varnothing
 \quad(\gamma\ne1).
\]
The domain must also satisfy the exact fundamental-domain convention in Li–Zhao Definition 3.4: weak-domain separation is \(\gamma\Pi\cap\operatorname{Int}(\Pi)=\varnothing\) unless \(\gamma\Pi=\Pi\), and the setwise stabilizer must be trivial. Do not replace this with a weak domain.

## Scope that must not change

No nondegeneracy assumption on the closed movable cone; no \(\mathbb Q\)-factoriality of the base; no restriction to K3 fibres or special deformation types; no bound on absolute dimension. Include relative dimensions zero, one and two. Preserve all pairs admitted by the chosen original definition. Do not silently replace pairs by \(\Delta=0\), replace numerical by linear triviality without justification, or replace the effective movable cone by its rational hull.

Technical convention differences (terminal pair versus terminal total space, boundary coefficients, projectivity of the base and relative equivalence conventions) must be checked against the original papers and recorded explicitly. Such an audit does not authorize narrowing this target.

## Sole completion objective

The sole objective of this archive is to resolve the exact main statement above. Literature acquisition, hyperedges, intermediate lemmas, counterexample searches and computation are means within the same continuing research loop. There is no separate intake-completion stage, fixed number of rounds, requirement to stop for another Pro, or local-improvement substitute target.

Continue useful proof and adversarial work until a complete mathematical resolution is established, the user explicitly pauses, or an actual platform/account/tool resource boundary prevents all available useful continuation. A local result, completed bibliography, structural check, paper formatting or elapsed self-imposed time is not a stopping condition. Document and preserve the exact state before a resource pause whenever possible; a pause is not resolution.

A complete proof must establish rational polyhedrality, exact effective-cone coverage and the full strong fundamental-domain condition for every original object, including degeneracy. A verified existing proof resolves the mathematical question but must not be presented as new. If the statement is false, supply an admissible geometric counterexample and identify the failed conclusion; the original proof task is then FAIL, not a successful proof or a repaired weaker theorem.

Previous G1-G8/paper-intake packaging is not a separate operating objective or reason to stop the loop. Mathematical correctness, exact scope and truthful evidence remain mandatory. Existing pinned intake records are evidence of earlier work and do not override this latest operating instruction.

# Original-only model input for future research RUNs

Work over the complex numbers. The original user specifies a normal projective Q-factorial total space X and a terminal Calabi-Yau fibre space f:(X,Delta)->S in the Li-Zhao convention, with K_X+Delta numerically trivial over S and dim X-dim S<=2. The exact numerical/linear-triviality equivalence, terminal/boundary convention and fibration convention must be reconciled from that source without silently changing the stated class.

V=N^1(X/S)_R; C=closed Mov(X/S) intersect Eff(X/S); Gamma is the image of PsAut(X/S,Delta) on V. A rational polyhedral cone is a closed convex cone with finitely many rational generators. The strong domain must cover C and satisfy Definition 3.4 weak-domain separation together with trivial setwise stabilizer in this action image. State the ambient space for interiors and justify full span whenever equating ambient and relative interiors.

No nondegeneracy of the closed movable cone is assumed. No Q-factoriality of S, K3-fibre condition, special deformation type or absolute-dimension bound is permitted. The entire mathematical target is in the separately pinned main_problem.md; no prior research result, example or candidate proof is included in this input.
